b8_dilatation.description: Geodetic dilatation rate - rate of volumetric strain (expansion/contraction)

b7_shear.description: Geodetic shear rate - rate of angular deformation from GPS/InSAR

b4_secondinvariant.description: Geodetic second invariant - measure of strain rate tensor magnitude

b13_isograv.description: Isostatic gravity anomaly - gravity after compensating for topographic mass

b18_isograv_hg.description: Isostatic gravity anomaly horizontal gradient - horizontal rate of change

b12_detrended_elev.description: Detrended elevation - topography with regional trends removed

b19_detrended_elev_slope.description: Detrended elevation slope - gradient of elevation after detrending

b6_radiometric_tc.description: Tilt angle or total curvature - magnetic field derivative for edge detection
